svg.title: EmbeddingGemma 2 multimodal facade: before (27a0407, 2 host waits) vs after (1 wait), 8 interleaved rounds, Apple M5 Pro
svg.text: EmbeddingGemma 2 multimodal facade: before (27a0407, 2 host waits) vs after (1 wait), 8 interleaved rounds, Apple M5 Pro

Label: median per-round ratio to before, [lowest, highest round]; 'best' = fastest round. Control = the before binary again: its own ratio and range are the noise floor of this run; a difference inside it is not a result. Time

g.text: encode, ms (min of N per round; bar = median)
